title: Set 7

sentences.ko: 위층에서 어젯밤 새벽 한 시까지 쿵쿵거리고 난리도 아니었어. 빗자루로 천장을 두드려 봤는데, 소용없더라.
sentences.text: The people upstairs were stomping around until like 1 AM last night. I banged on the ceiling with a broom, but it didn't do anything.

alts.text: Ugh, upstairs was stomping around till 1 AM. Banged on the ceiling, didn't do squat.
The upstairs neighbors were stomping around until around one in the morning, and it was extremely disruptive. I knocked on the ceiling with a broom, but it made no difference.

sentences.note: **stomping around** 은 쿵쿵거리며 시끄럽게 돌아다닌다는 뜻이에요. 층간소음 얘기할 때 딱 맞는 표현이에요.

sentences.ko: 미안, 늦었어. 다리 위에서 차가 완전 막혔거든. 문자라도 하려고 했는데, 나오기 직전에 폰이 꺼져버렸어.
sentences.text: Sorry I'm late, traffic was insane on the bridge. I would've texted, but my phone died right before I left.

alts.text: Sorry, traffic was crazy on the bridge. Would've texted you but my phone died right before I left.
I apologize for being late. Traffic was terrible on the bridge, and I would have texted you, but my phone battery died right before I left.

sentences.note: **traffic was insane** 은 차가 말도 안 되게 막혔다는 뜻이에요. insane 은 놀랄 정도로 심하다는 강조 표현이에요.

sentences.ko: 계란이 지금 한 판에 칠 달러나 해, 진짜 말이 안 돼. 예전엔 사십 달러면 카트가 꽉 찼는데, 이제는 칠십 달러는 있어야 돼.
sentences.text: Eggs are like seven bucks a dozen now, it's insane. I used to fill up my cart for forty dollars, now it's more like seventy.

alts.text: Seven bucks for a dozen eggs now, it's wild. Forty bucks used to fill my whole cart, now it's like seventy.
Egg prices have gone up to about seven dollars a dozen, which is quite excessive. Groceries that used to cost forty dollars now cost closer to seventy.

sentences.note: **bucks** 는 dollar 를 편하게 부르는 말이에요. seven bucks 는 칠 달러라는 뜻이죠.

sentences.ko: 역 근처 카페 세 군데를 가봤는데, 다 사람이 꽉 찼더라. 결국 네 번째 집에서 이십 분 기다려서 겨우 자리 잡았어.
sentences.text: I tried three cafes near the station, and they were all packed. I finally got a seat at the fourth one, after waiting twenty minutes.

alts.text: Tried like three cafes by the station and they were all slammed. Ended up waiting twenty minutes at the fourth place just to sit down.
I visited three different cafes near the station, and all of them were completely full. I eventually found a seat at the fourth cafe after waiting twenty minutes.

sentences.note: **packed** 는 사람이 꽉 차서 자리가 없다는 뜻이에요. 카페나 식당이 붐빌 때 딱 맞는 표현이에요.

sentences.ko: 지난주에 150달러짜리 블렌더 샀는데, 딱 한 번밖에 안 썼나 봐. 영수증 있을 때 그냥 환불할 걸 그랬어.
sentences.text: I bought this $150 blender last week and I've used it like once. I should've just returned it while I still had the receipt.

alts.text: Dropped $150 on a blender last week and only used it once. Guess I should've returned it while I had the receipt.
I purchased a $150 blender last week, but I have only used it once. I probably should have returned it while I still had the receipt.

sentences.note: **should've just returned it** 은 그냥 환불할 걸 그랬다는 후회를 나타내는 표현이에요.

reviewed: 1번 casual에 원문에 없던 "again"을 넣어 실제로는 없는 '재발' 뉘앙스가 생겨서 뺐다.
1번 formal이 핵심 내용인 "stomping around"(쿵쿵거림)를 "making a lot of noise"로 뭉뚱그려 뜻을 눅였다 — formal에도 stomping을 살려 고쳤다.
3번 casual이 본문과 문두가 거의 겹치고(마지막 형용사 한 단어만 다름) 구별이 안 돼서 어순과 표현을 바꿔 충분히 다르게 고쳤다.
5번 casual이 본문에서 대명사만 뺀 수준으로 거의 그대로라 표현을 바꿔 구별되게 고쳤다.
5번은 ko가 "십오만 원"(원화)인데 text/alts는 "$150"(달러)라 서로 다른 통화·금액을 말하고 있어서, ko를 "150달러"로 바꿔 통일했다.
